mostWorthwhile.text: Matching the corrected request to the cooler's model plate was most satisfying: the correction changed the actual repair, not just the wording.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the motor to its power lead was straightforward and less engaging than clearing the trapped thread or seeing the sign turn.

surprise.text: Moth confidently turned train noise into a plausible but wrong computer-repair request; Sal's correction changed it to a cooling job.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the named source-and-correction interface was a convenient, ready-made solution whose workings remained abstract.

continue.text: Yes. The combination of tangible repairs, Moth's personality and the consequences of correcting its mistake makes me curious about what happens next.
